answer.summary: API types check failed because the committed src/utils/api-types.d.ts is stale. Regenerating from the running API changes SettingsRuntimeUpdateInput.settings from Record<string, object> to Record<string, any>, which the PR's runtime-settings change caused. The failure is deterministic, so a rerun will fail again. Fix: run yarn generate-types-from-api and commit the updated file.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
